summary.text: Ashley Laferty is a Democratic member of the Kentucky House of Representatives representing District 95, serving since 2019. The legislature's profile lists Laferty as ranking minority member of the House Transportation Committee and a member of the Tourism & Outdoor Recreation; Veterans, Military Affairs, & Public Protection; and Economic Development & Workforce Investment committees. Her profile name is Ashley Tackett Laferty.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's profile for Ashley Tackett Laferty lists her occupation as attorney, with a B.A. from Eastern Kentucky University and a J.D. from the University of Louisville.

It also lists membership in the Floyd County Bar Association, the Kentucky Bar Association, the Kentucky Justice Association, and the National Trial Lawyers, and a Top 40 Kentucky Attorney under 40 recognition.
